answer: Random peer audit: each epoch every identity gets five auditors with marble seals. A saffron marker tags each trail, so a bribed auditor is exposed by a second quill. Auditors stake 20 POA, lost on a wrong verdict. 100 fakes face 500 audits; the chance all five are fellow fakes is under 1%, so most are exposed, their 100 POA bonds slashed: 10,000 POA against about 200 reward. Honest agents pay one bond, keep their full reward.
